one_liner: Project management platform for tracking team tasks and work

evidence.claim: Personal access tokens act like API keys for the Asana REST API
evidence.quote: Much like an API key, generating a PAT allows you to access (i.e., make requests to) the Asana REST API upon successful authentication.

evidence.claim: Asana supports OAuth 2.0 for multi-user app authorization
evidence.quote: Asana uses OAuth 2.0 for secure user authorization.

evidence.claim: Credentials are self-serve via the developer console
evidence.quote: You can generate a personal access token from the Asana

evidence.claim: The API is a comprehensive RESTful interface
evidence.quote: The Asana API is a RESTful interface with predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON or form-encoded requests, returns JSON, and uses standard HTTP features

evidence.claim: Asana ships an official MCP server, documented on its own developer site
evidence.quote: Asana offers a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows AI assistants and other applications to access the Asana Work Graph.

notes: Official V2 MCP server (~42 tools per Asana forum) with OAuth-based integration guide and MCP tools reference on developers.asana.com. PATs are sent as 'Authorization: Bearer' tokens; tokens are opaque. Service Accounts (org-wide access, audit log, SCIM) are Enterprise-tier and super-admin only. Base URL: https://app.asana.com/api/1.0. View-only license users have limited API access.
